area: Inline Add and Edit Parts - Full View Edit
title: Full View Edit opens the part details modal pre-populated
permissions_required: Work Order Line - Create and Edit; Work Order View Mode
preconditions: In the top menu click “Work Orders”, then open a work order whose status is Estimate, Approved, In Progress, or Review (click its row in the list). Open its Lines tab — each work order line has its own Parts section beneath it, where the “Add Part” button and part lines appear. (Route drafted from the spec/design and marked PROVISIONAL — confirm the exact tab name and Parts-section placement on the build.)
Your user has the 'Work Order Line - Create and Edit' permission enabled (an administrator sets this on your user role; confirm the exact path on the build).
Your 'Work Orders → Work Order View Mode' permission is set to Full View (an administrator sets this on your user role; confirm the exact path on the build).
The work order line already has at least one part listed in its Parts section (if not, add one first with “Add Part”).
steps: Select Edit on an existing part line.
expected:
1. The part details modal opens, pre-populated with the part's current values.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-9315 and story SV-9320 (Story 5, Edit Part - Full View) and the Inline Add and Edit Parts on Work Order Lines specification version 16, section S5-R1, read on 31 August 2026.
